name: In Rainbows
description_preview:
In Rainbows is the seventh studio album by the English rock band Radiohead. It was first released independently on 10 October 2007 as a digital download that customers could order for whatever price they saw fit, including for free. Despite this radical release method, the band actually made more money off this method than they did on their previous release, Hail to the Thief. The band eventually made a standard CD release and a deluxe-edition box set available in most countries during the last week of 2007.

Without a doubt, In Rainbows is one of Radiohead’s most orchestral records. The warm arrangements and sounds gather to create sonic emotions that raised the bar for art rock.

body.plain: The cover art for Radiohead’s 2007 album In Rainbows is an explosive, fluid abstract image created by the band’s longtime visual collaborator, Stanley Donwood. Rather than using traditional digital design, Donwood experimented with photographic chemistry by pouring tartaric acid and various colorful dyes onto light-sensitive paper, capturing the unpredictable, bleeding textures that mimic a cosmic explosion or a toxic, glowing nebula. The final image balances a dark, star-like background with a vivid, melting streak of warm oranges, reds, and cool blues. When released physically, this striking, chaotic backdrop was contrasted with the album’s title spelled out in a blocky, stylized typography that repeats the words in a shimmering, rainbow-hued gradient, perfectly mirroring the album’s blend of warm, organic human emotion and sleek, digital precision.
